bullets: New: A light/dark button at the top right, next to refresh and full screen. Your choice stays on this computer, and full screen follows it.

Changed: The Dev updates bell now sits next to the name at the top left of full screen, and isn't in the side pane. A red dot means something new. Click the bell to read it; nothing pops up on its own.
New: Full screen has its own refresh button, and opens a little larger.
Changed: The Dev Update bell floats again. Drag it anywhere; it starts at the bottom right.
New: When you open the add-in, it asks for your name once a day. Pick yours, or add it if you're new. Pre-check ticks, notes, code rules and saved audits say who did them.
New: Your name shows at the top of the pane. Press Switch user if someone else takes over.
New: A loading screen shows each step while the workbook is read.
Changed: Refresh and full screen are icons at the top right; hover over one to see what it does. This bell sits next to them and lists what changed.
